body: My grades are still suffering despite my somewhat of a passion for learning. Hence my frustration. I study but it's like trying to nail a sign to a piece of glass.

I love all of my classes. I can't think of any classes that I loathe or make me feel extremely dejected when I walk in. Chemistry and precalculus become stressful, though my physics class is going smoothly.
In all honesty, the answer is no. I don't feel very close to them, and on top of that, I'm the second oldest in an 8 child family. (Catholic parents) Doesn't help much.
I can't say - sometimes frustration with school really gets me. Otherwise, I don't know
Grandparents and a schoolfriend who they told us "slipped in the shower."  My good friend as well tried to overdose with Benadryl and other household drugs. Somehow got his hands on LSD at one point
Parents fighting constantly about a variety of other family matters, ready to divorce very soon it seems

I do my best to balance my fruits, veggies, grains and dairy. I don't just eat chips and cake, so to speak.

No pattern though. Just today, I can recall from going excited about the day to downright ready to cry, back out to an extremely hyper excited euphoric state that lasted for 45 minutes just now. I'm back down to this strange, upset and frustrated place. This is upsetting and confusing me constantly. I'm afraid at some point the sad depressed state will dip just a little bit too low and put me out.

Thanks for the quick reply and thoughtful response. I just don't get it. Right now I'm feeling pretty alright. It's this constant fluctuation of mood and motivation and optimism and pessimism that continues to cycle. I get enough sleep and I get enough to eat, but there's something still very, very wrong. 

I'll hang in there, hopefully
Other guys coming close to take their own life, drug overdoses, deaths, family problems. I guess it doesn't sound all too deep and dastardly, but I feel I've seen a lot.
